title: Information gathering
summary: The starting point recorded in the original journey.
detail: This is the first dated entry in the original portfolio timeline.

title: The portfolio begins
summary: The first version of the site enters development.
detail: The initial project established a shared home for the designer’s profile and work.

title: A gallery for selected work
summary: Projects gain a dedicated place on the page.
detail: The first project section brought examples together so visitors could browse beyond the introduction.

title: Space for client feedback
detail: The early portfolio introduced a section for client voices. The current template keeps this section editable and displays it when approved quotes are available.

title: The journey becomes a timeline
summary: Dated cards bring the portfolio’s history into view.

title: A content-driven portfolio
summary: Individual project pages and a design journal arrive.
detail: Astro builds each entry from Markdown. New work and articles can now be published by adding a content file.
